name: Mythos Ever After: A Cthulhu Dating Sim
source:
Welcome to Hallowearth Academy!
As the premiere university of the Dreamlands, a feral and altogether rowdy planet beyond time, space, and human understanding, it boasts an extensive alumni of world-ending and world-beginning warrior-mages! Will you be one of them? Will you even survive your freshman year? (That's not a joke, most of our freshman class is slaughtered early on)

Make friends, make enemies, make significant others, make other significant others jealous that you are stealing their significant other! Wake some Old Gods! Who knows what tomfoolery you will run into? Look no further, for you, gentle video game player, have found the greatest elder horror dating simulator in all of the land!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
歡迎來到霍洛厄斯學院！
這裡是幻夢境首屈一指的大學。幻夢境是一顆超越時間、空間與人類理解的狂野而喧鬧的星球，本校則擁有大批足以毀滅世界、開創新世的戰鬥法師校友！你能成為其中一員嗎？你甚至能活過大一嗎？這可不是玩笑，我們的大一新生大多很早就被殺了。

交朋友，樹敵，找戀人，再搶走別人的戀人，讓對方吃醋！喚醒幾位古神！誰知道你會碰上怎樣的胡鬧？無需再找，親愛的電子遊戲玩家，你已經找到了這片土地上最棒的遠古恐怖戀愛模擬遊戲！

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431470/]Steam[/url]］
